requirements.description: Real handlers for every applicable event, argument shape and assertion; reject unknown names, fields and arguments before injection. Observers never synthesize input, completion, reaping or failure.

Coalesced and every-byte reads; wrong direction, unknown names, immutable bindings, sequence/arrival/capacity exhaustion, semantic duplicate start/invoke and released-arrival duplicates as applicable. Reuse shared retired-terminal cases; add absent shared cases before recording pass.

Coalesced and every-byte reads; wrong direction, unknown command/point, immutable bindings, sequence/arrival/capacity exhaustion, semantic duplicate start/invoke, released-arrival duplicates and retired cancel as applicable. Add absent shared cases before recording pass.
Actual blocked/broken writer and EOF at startup, active, post-terminal and Stop; parent cleanup, bounded deadlines and process reaping. Fake-clock data validation is insufficient.
Actual blocked/broken writer and EOF at startup, active, post-terminal and Stop; watchdog self-termination with parent cleanup independently observed. Fake-clock data validation is insufficient.
Pinned Spring manager, driver and pool prove begin failure, rollback-only, unknown rollback and suppressed lease-close failure, with independently observed proxy, transaction and lease milestones.
A selected command runs through its actual JDK proxy and the pinned Spring/MySQL transaction; independent driver and lease observations precede terminal publication.
Inactive sync points return immediately without stdin, protocol loops or transaction changes.
Required startup/invoke/terminal/Stop/stopped/EOF/exit-zero/Reset family has an executable predicate and friendly missing-case failure.
Required startup/invoke/terminal/Stop/stopped/EOF/exit-zero family has an executable predicate; Reset is observed in Go/paired evidence.
Close command_exception arguments and phase vocabulary to command_body, jdbc_operation and after_commit_callback; reject an unknown phase before injection.
Compose post-terminal fatal/evaluation invalidation with bounded Stop, child termination/reaping and Reset rejection, retaining the original fault.
Explicit elapsed-clock inputs compare wire Stop budgets with the original graceful cutoff at zero elapsed, delayed writes and sub-millisecond exhaustion. G4 budget composition remains #110.
Track actual invoke delivery separately from local reservation; reject accepted before dispatch receipt.
Observe emitted cancel reason from context/Stop origin and first-latched reason when both occur.
Observe terminal cancellation reason from the first delivered cancellation origin, including context/Stop competition.
Run live Go and Java peers after their separate applicable shared cases pass at the same vector pin. Link both accepted manifests; adversarial isolated scripts are not live paired histories.
Real MySQL vulnerable WG001/exit 2 and fixed PASS/exit 0, reset isolation, blocked DB, rollback, cancellation and application death; exact repeated commands, versions, artifacts and CI markers.
